name: back pec stretch
source_instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Cross your arms in front of your body, with your right arm over your left arm.
Interlock your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms up and away from your body, feeling a stretch in your back and chest.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
interpretation: Cross the arms, clasp/interlock fingers with palms directed away, then raise the hands up/away to a comfortable reach. Demonstrate one crossing side in a5s2/1/2 stretch cycle; retain15–30s source hold and opposite-side instruction. Distinguish real clasp and continuous wrist orientation from hand centroids meeting through each other. Exact reach, elbow poles and cadence are authored. Grip acquisition follows reachable arm placement; reverse path releases fingers before unwinding. Preserved shoulder correctives have explicit zero tracks. The separately authored WrapRightOverCuff POSITION/NORMAL component follows the3995 shoulder-protraction fraction and resets explicitly in all other actions.
